definitions.explanation: A meeting or gathering of people, often with a warm or communal connotation. Frequently used for informal community events, social gatherings, or club meetings. Slightly softer and more intimate than {集会|しゅうかい}.

examples.japanese: {地域|ちいき}の{集|つど}いに{参加|さんか}した。
{月|つき}に{一度|いちど}、{読書|どくしょ}{好|ず}きの{集|つど}いが{開|ひら}かれている。
examples.english: A gathering of book lovers is held once a month.

examples.japanese: {同窓生|どうそうせい}の{集|つど}いで{久|ひさ}しぶりに{旧友|きゅうゆう}と{再会|さいかい}した。
examples.english: I reunited with old friends at an alumni gathering after a long time.

notes:
USAGE:
{集|つど}い is the noun form of the verb {集|つど}う (to gather). It has a warm, communal tone and is often used for social or community events rather than formal meetings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {集|つど}いに{参加|さんか}する (to attend a gathering)
- {集|つど}いを{開|ひら}く (to hold a gathering)
- {仲間|なかま}の{集|つど}い (a gathering of friends/companions)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {集|つど}い: gathering (warm, communal tone)
- {集会|しゅうかい}: assembly (more formal, sometimes political)
- {会合|かいごう}: meeting (business or organizational)
- {寄|よ}り{合|あ}い: informal get-together (neighborhood/community)
